answer: Non-transferable earnings: rewards stay bound to the account that earned them and can only pay that account's own fees or stake, never move to another wallet. A sybil farm then can't funnel a thousand thin balances into one reef of capital; each fake must be nursed alone to usefulness, so the attacker pays full upkeep per identity while the payoff per account sits at its nadir, and the plume of fake accounts never pools into real power.
